As Philip Morris International (PM) Stock Declined, Meritage Portfolio Management Has Cut Stake; Macguire Cheswick & Tuttle Investment Counsel Holding in Fiserv (FISV) Has Raised by $8.49 Million
June 25, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Meritage Portfolio Management decreased its stake in Philip Morris International (PM) by 36.16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Meritage Portfolio Management sold 19,392 shares as the company’s stock declined 24.69% with the market. The institutional investor held 34,242 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.40M, down from 53,634 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Meritage Portfolio Management who had been investing in Philip Morris International for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $123.88 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.62% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $79.69. About 3.11M shares traded. Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE:PM) has declined 32.76% since June 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 45.33% the S&P500.
